scope: G3 functional branch only: test-only selection of the reserved first index job, dispatched by the closed direct worker publisher over a real migrated V2 owner with a selected Start reservation in a real bootstrapped C cut, and a cold verifier for the selected job selection; no production change, production caller, produced image, GWIN0 package, installed run or native C activation

branch_policy.owner_decision: On 29 October 2026 the owner kept further sequence-19 G2 testing and GWIN0 completion on feature/g3-gwin0-beta and moved G3 functional development to this branch; on 31 October 2026 the owner approved this step in the words: may I add the step that turns the reserved first index job into the selected job, plus its reopen check? yes

implementation: The closed direct worker publisher turns a selected first index job Start reservation into the selected job. C re-derives the reservation's transition and job bytes from the selected reservation record and the owner; it accepts no worker JSON, review hash or job bytes

The selection needs a new original worker effect, never the reservation's own operation, attributed to the same binding, input and review with the index preparation purpose, and it is rechecked live. The reservation's input, fixed builder identity, owner, physical accounting and segments must still match, and the first job review is recomputed and compared with the reserved transition

The observed writer's budget is computed from the exact reserved write set and must fit the reservation's liability. The writer begins only when the actual store walk equals the C-selected owner accounting, so a store ahead of C is refused before any write or NV dispatch

The worker writes the job blob once under the retained owner writer, reads it back against the C-derived bytes and measures the store again; the measured growth in allocated bytes, regular files and directories must stay inside the reserved liability, logical bytes must not decrease, no new incomplete object may appear and the compiled capacity policy must admit the measured accounting

Only then does C build one event, domain luma-c-index-job-selection-v1, that replaces the owner leaf (its measured accounting) and the index leaf (the selected job) together; every page, record and descriptor is prepared and read back before the sole NV dispatch. The store write is data until that event is selected

The direct reader routes a selected job selection to a new cold verifier: the previous cut must be a bootstrap, V1, migration, reservation or selection cut bound by frame hash and NV chain, with the same binding, legacy state and phase and sequence and ordinal one higher

The cold verifier re-reads the selection record within its closed class, requires the consumed reservation to be this owner's selected index leaf, replays the exact owner and index role edits from both cuts' own roots, and rebuilds the deterministic layout and physical closure. The measured accounting is selection data bounded by the reservation's liability; the job blob is not re-read, and nothing dispatches or allocates
The cold V1, owner migration and Start reservation verifiers accept a previous selection cut; an index phase preparation still has no cold verifier and a cut over one is refused
The publisher still has no production caller; production builds do not compile the direct publisher, its cold verifiers or the new test-only variants

slice6_checks.results_format: Each results entry is [result, passed, failed, filtered_out, seconds]

test_behaviour: Each test first runs a real bounded owner migration into a real side-by-side v2 store, so Start and job selection run over the actual C-selected migrated V2 owner

After one Start reservation is dispatched and cold-reopened, a job selection under the reservation's own original, under a substituted builder identity, under an original for a different Start input, with a Publish purpose and with a revoked original is each refused before NV and before any store write, with the store inventory unchanged
One selection is then exactly one NV dispatch; before it the job blob is complete in the store with no new incomplete object, and its bytes read back as the C-derived job bytes

A cold reopen selects the exact job selection through the new cold verifier: the same binding, input digest, selection and original attribution, sequence one higher, a changed owner leaf with the same entry count and a changed index leaf
A second selection and a second Start over the selected job are refused before NV with the store unchanged, and the cold reopen still selects the job
A store left ahead of C by an interrupted attempt (the exact job blob written, no C event) is refused before NV with the store unchanged, and the cold reopen still selects the reservation
The lost-reply Start test is unchanged from the index Start checkpoint and still passes
verification.full_platform_suite_note: The three platform filters are disjoint and together cover every luma-platform test once: index_cases, the rest of custody::v2_publication and everything outside custody::v2_publication (3 + 107 + 1512 = 1622, 42 of them ignored by their own attributes)
verification.dispatched: test builds only; no production caller

not_claimed: Reconciliation of an interrupted selection attempt that left the job blob in the store with nothing selected; a retry is refused and the reservation's liability stays charged
Cold re-verification of the job blob or other object-store bytes; the cold verifier replays the C records and roots only
A cold lineage verifier for an index phase preparation; a cut over one is refused
A C reservation of the fresh v2 namespace or joined protected C counters
Running the selected job, any index phase preparation after it or a published index generation
A production index grant shape, a production caller, an installed run or native C activation
Reconciliation of an unselected pending worker attempt after a lost NV reply
Delta overlay, snapshot backup delivery or a V2 owner creation route
Artifact CLI harness passage, installed PAM, physical TPM, loaded LSM or Hyper-V qualification
Any produced image or GWIN0 package; G3 and GWIN0 remain open
